acceptance_criteria: Freeze commit is the sole first branch commit and introduces only this valid JSON preregistration.
Draft PR anchor is created before any read-closure repair or estimator implementation.
DM-077 read-closure repair is implemented and passes before estimator source is introduced.
DM-073 values/blocker inventory are consumed from the frozen preregistration.
Exact covariance, weights, normalization, estimator point, variance, and finite-resolution enclosure are independently testable.
Published Bayesian result and BIPM values are absent from estimator-driving API/state.
One complete Python suite passes on the final tree.
Only relevant read-only guards are added.

estimator_definition.absolute_standard_uncertainty_rule: For displayed midpoint x_i in units of 1e-11 and relative standard uncertainty s_i ppm, u_i = x_i * s_i / 1e6 in the same displayed units.
failure_conditions: correlation matrix not symmetric with unit diagonal
linear solve singular or normalization denominator zero
estimator_definition.matrix_arithmetic: exact rational Gaussian elimination; no binary floating-point decision path
estimator_definition.point_estimate_rule: G_hat = sum_i w_i x_i using the displayed midpoint values.
estimator_definition.weights_rule: Solve V z = 1 exactly; w = z / sum(z). Do not constrain weight signs.

finite_resolution_definition.aggregate_enclosure: Map the four closed input cells through the fixed linear estimator using sign-aware exact interval extrema.
finite_resolution_definition.input_cells: Each displayed G value denotes a closed half-last-digit decimal cell at six decimal places.
finite_resolution_definition.rounding_claim_limit: The enclosure represents publication-resolution ambiguity under the frozen summary-level estimator; it does not recover the authors' hidden unrounded values.
finite_resolution_definition.weight_policy: Estimator weights are fixed from the source-reported displayed midpoints and Table 18 covariance summary; they are not recomputed over hidden values inside the display cells.

input_projection.precision_policy: Table 18 precise combined relative standard uncertainties control estimator covariance; Table 16 whole-ppm uncertainty labels are display-only corroboration.

known_prior_information.allowed_claim: Target-independent deterministic implementation of the prospectively frozen experimental-only generalized least-squares estimator and its finite-resolution representation.
known_prior_information.reason: The four determinations, Table 18 covariance inputs, the published Bayesian final result, the BIPM discrepancy, and Claude's qualitative observation that a GLS combination is numerically close to equation (64) were known before this freeze. No blind-discovery claim is permitted.

mutation_requirements: off-diagonal experimental correlations must affect the estimator
Table 18 precise uncertainties must not be replaced by Table 16 rounded uncertainty labels
absolute covariance scaling by the four displayed G midpoints must remain load-bearing
all four determinations must contribute under the frozen input order
NIST equation (64) and Bayesian/dark-uncertainty outputs must not enter estimator construction
finite-resolution input cells must not collapse to midpoint points
sign-aware enclosure logic must remain correct for arbitrary signed generalized weights
the estimator must preserve exact unbiased normalization
objective: Construct a deterministic project-defined generalized minimum-variance unbiased estimator from the four NIST 2026 Table 16 determinations and the Table 18 experimental covariance, with exact rational arithmetic and a finite-publication-resolution enclosure. This is not a reproduction of the paper's Bayesian equation (64).

preregistered_preconditions.freeze_control: All four Table 18 precise uncertainties and all Bayesian blocker ids are frozen here and any module constants must be derived from frozen bytes rather than independently hard-coded. This satisfies DM-073.
preregistered_preconditions.read_closure_repair: Before any n=4 estimator implementation is added, add a permanent test that instruments the existing NIST feasibility build read closure and proves repository file reads are confined to its declared SOURCE_PATHS. This satisfies DM-077/DM-070 within the scientific PR rather than via a maintenance-only PR.

scientific_constraints: Do not use NIST equation (64), Table 19 dark uncertainties/configuration effects, CODATA, or any BIPM value in estimator construction.
Do not call this estimator the NIST published consensus estimator.
Do not perform a BIPM-14 versus NIST-26 common-constant comparison in this PR.
Do not assign a p-value or probabilistic common-constant interpretation.
Preserve the PR #46 Bayesian NO-GO boundary.
Do not cross the HUST AAF E-001 evidence-classification boundary.

source.publication: Stephan Schlamminger et al., Redetermination of the gravitational constant with the BIPM torsion balance at NIST
